## You describe it. Claude designs it. Conway runs it.

Conway's Game of Life runs on a few simple rules, so a seed's future is set the moment it's placed: play it again and it does exactly the same thing. The creative part is choosing the seed. **Life with AI** lets you describe the outcome you want (a bloom, a collision, a garden of oscillators) and Claude designs a starting pattern, tests it, and refines it live on the board, lit by a GPU-shader neon glow that heats up where cells crowd together.

It's Conway's Game of Life reimagined in Flutter. Every seed is a shareable link that plays on a phone or in a browser, with nothing to install, and the new Community tab collects the seeds people have found. This is the first versioned release; it grew from [an earlier Java/Swing version](https://github.com/shanepkearney/life).
